key_facts.reason_jp: 流通株式時価総額基準への適合、EPS・ROE向上、株主還元充実

summary_en: ¥40M upper limit, 40,000 shares (5.65% of S/O ex-treasury), market purchases via TSE from 7 Aug 2026 to 31 Jul 2027. Ratio of 40,000 ÷ 707,540 = 5.65%. Reason: improve EPS and ROE, enhance shareholder returns, support market value amid monitoring-designation status; execution period set to precede June 2027 listing-standard compliance deadline.
summary_jp: 上限4,000万円、40,000株（発行済株式総数（自己株式を除く）707,540株に対し5.65%）、2026年8月7日から2027年7月31日まで市場買付け。流通株式時価総額基準の適合に向けた環境整備、EPS・ROEの向上、株主還元の充実を目的。
tag_en: Buyback - 40,000 shares (5.65% S/O) - ¥40M - Market purchase - Aug 2026–Jul 2027
